validation_basis: Absolute APICAM camera-model fit: 36 bright stars on ESO APICAM APICAM.2018-06-14T04:00:23.000 (same-frame fit; not an independent absolute hold-out). v35.10 temporal hold-out: four independent ESO archive frames at 03:57:55, 04:02:50, 04:05:18, and 04:07:45 UTC; 10 bright-star centroids per frame stayed within max 2.94 px of their reference detector positions (RMS 0.91-2.65 px), confirming sidereal tracking stability. Because this temporal test does not independently establish absolute sky coordinates, direction/Csys quality intentionally remains planning.
